payload.question: Does ML trained on simulator-generated AC N-1 labels beat transparent DC-LODF and pre-loading screening, across operating points and across networks?
payload.label_note: All labels are simulator-generated (pandapower AC power flow on PGLib-OPF cases); they are not historical outages.

models.dc_lodf_rule: DC-LODF screening on base AC P-flows: flag if max estimated loading > 100 %
models.dc_lodf_tuned: Same DC-LODF score, flag threshold tuned for F1 on the training split
models.pre_loading: Pre-contingency AC loading of the outaged branch; threshold tuned for F1 on train

dc_lodf_rule.description: DC-LODF screening on base AC P-flows: flag if max estimated loading > 100 %

dc_lodf_tuned.description: Same DC-LODF score, flag threshold tuned for F1 on the training split

pre_loading.description: Pre-contingency AC loading of the outaged branch; threshold tuned for F1 on train

runtime.note: AC N-1 = sequential pandapower runpp per contingency (numba, 1 thread); screening = feature extraction from the solved base case + model scoring.
runtime.timing_scope: Means over generation operating points (including train); model scoring averaged over 20 full test batches. Excludes solved base AC state, one-time PTDF/LODF/topology preprocessing, and model fitting.
